summary: This dataset involves a genome-wide association study (GWAS) to identify genetic variants associated with diabetic retinopathy (DR) in African American and Caucasian populations. The study combines existing genotyping data from individuals with type 2 diabetes and DR, incorporating admixture association and covariate modeling to increase power. The analysis will be replicated in additional populations, including South Asians and East Asians, and fine-mapped using cross-population meta-analysis of HapMap and 1000 Genomes variants.
